Statute.Title: An Act to change the names of certain electoral districts, 2026
Statute.OtherLangTitle: (Loi de 2026 visant à changer le nom de certaines circonscriptions électorales)

Minister.Text: Introduced by Minister of Transport and Leader of the Government in the House of Commons

CIF.Text: CIF, 2026, c. 20 (assent: 18.06.2026), s. 88 in force on the 90th day after the day on which the Strong and Free Elections Act receives royal assent, see s. 89 (16.09.2026)
